notes:
Drawing check: fewer false alarms. A grey or black line beside a run is no longer taken for the pipe unless it is drawn at the item's size at the drawing's scale, so a dashed line, wall or border next to a run no longer holds it.
The drawing check record is tidier: one line and one pin for each run placed against the check (its points named together), and a reason already written on the record is referred to ("as line 1") instead of repeated. Existing lines are left as they are.
